system_prompt:
# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content: Hi, I’d like to exchange a couple of items I bought recently—a water bottle and a desk lamp. I need a bigger water bottle, and for the lamp, I’d prefer something less bright, ideally one that uses an AC adapter instead of batteries or USB. Can you help me with that?
Hello? Are you still there? I’d like to exchange my water bottle for a bigger one, and the desk lamp for a less bright model that uses an AC adapter. What do I need to do to start the exchange?
Hello, is there anything else you need from me to process the exchange? I’m ready to provide any details you need.
Hi, just checking in—do you need any more information from me to help with the exchange for the desk lamp and water bottle? I’m happy to provide whatever you need.

Thanks — I can help with that. Before I can start, I need to verify your account and get a few details so the exchange can be processed.

Please provide one of the following so I can find your user id:
- your account email, or
- your first & last name plus zip code

Also please confirm or provide:
1) The order id (if you have it). If you don’t have it, I can look up recent delivered orders once I locate your account.
2) Confirmation that the order status is delivered and that you have the water bottle and desk lamp ready to exchange.
3) Whether you want me to search for replacement items that match your requirements (bigger water bottle; a less-bright desk lamp that uses an AC adapter). If yes, I’ll show available options for you to pick.
4) Which payment method you want to use for any price difference or refund (refund can go to original payment method or to an existing gift card on your account).

Once you provide your email (or name + zip), and tell me if you want me to search for replacement options, I’ll look up your orders and present the available replacement items and the exchange details for your confirmation before making any changes.

I don’t remember the email I used, but my name is Mei Kovacs and my zip code is 28236.

I don’t have the order ID handy, but the order was delivered and I have both the water bottle and the desk lamp here, ready to exchange.

Yes, please search for replacement options for the desk lamp—a less bright one that uses an AC adapter would be perfect. For now, let’s just go ahead with exchanging the desk lamp.

If there’s any price difference, a refund to my original payment method is fine.

Sorry — I ran into a system error when trying to look up your account by name and zip. I can retry that lookup, or you can give me the account email to speed things up.

Quick recap of what you asked so I handle it correctly:
- You want to exchange only the desk lamp for now (not the water bottle).
- Replacement lamp should be less bright and use an AC adapter (no batteries or USB).
- You have the delivered lamp ready for exchange.
- Any price difference should be refunded to your original payment method.

Please tell me which you prefer:
- Option A — I retry the lookup now using your name Mei Kovacs and zip 28236, or
- Option B — you provide the account email to locate your user id.

Once I locate your account and order, I’ll:
1) Confirm the delivered order and the lamp item id with you.
2) Search available lamp replacement items that match “less bright” + “AC adapter” and present choices.
3) After you pick the replacement, I’ll show the exact exchange details (items, any price difference, and refund/payment method) and ask you to confirm (you must reply “yes” to proceed).
4) Then I’ll submit the exchange request.

Which option would you like — retry lookup or provide email?
Let’s go with Option A—please retry the lookup using my name, Mei Kovacs, and zip code, 28236. Thank you!

Sorry — I keep hitting a system error when trying to look up your account by name and zip. I can’t complete the authentication step right now with the automated lookup.

Please choose one of the options below so we can continue:
1) I can try the name+zip lookup again right now. (I’ll retry the lookup.)
2) You can provide the account email and I’ll look up your user id that way.
3) If you prefer, I can transfer you to a human agent to complete this right away.

If you pick option 2, please reply with the email you used on the account.  
If you pick option 3, please confirm and I will transfer you.

Once your account is located I will:
- Find the delivered order and confirm the lamp item id with you,
- Search available replacement lamps that are less bright and use an AC adapter,
- Present replacement choices and the exact exchange details (including any price difference and refund to your original payment method),
- Proceed with the exchange only after you explicitly confirm “yes.”

Which option do you want?
Let’s try option 1—please retry the name and zip lookup one more time. If it still doesn’t work, I guess I’ll need to be transferred to a human agent. Thanks for your help!

arguments.summary: User Mei Kovacs (zip 28236) requests an exchange for a delivered desk lamp to a less-bright model that uses an AC adapter. They have the original lamp and water bottle ready but want to exchange only the desk lamp now. They prefer any price difference refunded to the original payment method. User does not have the order ID. Automated lookup by name+zip failed repeatedly (system error) when attempted three times; user asked to retry once more and to transfer to human if lookup continues to fail.

messages.content: YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.
